data.name: access.refused
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.Refused: a row level security policy denied a save the application's own checks let through. No arguments.

data.name: access.role-not-allowed
data.value: The role this sign-in carries gives no access here: {Role}.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.RoleNotAllowed: a signed-in user's token carries a role the host gave no database role, so nothing ran for it. {Role} is the role the token carries.

data.name: access.not-signed-in
data.value: Only a signed-in user can do this.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.NotSignedIn: a request requires a signed-in user, and the caller did not sign in, or is the application's own work. No arguments.

data.name: access.system-only
data.value: Only the application itself can do this.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.SystemOnly: a request requires system work, and the caller is a user or did not sign in. No arguments.

data.name: Unspecified
data.comment: ValidationError.UnspecifiedCode: a Validate() override refused without saying why. {ValueObject} is the type name.

data.name: ValueObjectValidator
data.comment: MustBeValid() in DDDToolkit.FluentValidation. {PropertyName} is the property, {ValueObject} the value object type.
